title: ParameterFreeHeavyTailedSmooth.lean

problem_class.label: nonconvex
problem_class.details: Lower-bounded differentiable objectives with globally L-Lipschitz gradients; convexity is not required. The initial gap to a lower bound is at most Δ, with L,Δ>0.

oracle.label: stochastic_gradient
oracle.details: One unbiased gradient sample g(x,ω) per call, with i.i.d. seeds; only gradient samples are supplied.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/ParameterFreeHeavyTailedSmooth.lean: spec.admissible, oracle answer and unbiasedness clauses; LongTails/Setups/StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.lean: IID

distinctive_assumptions.label: unknown_smoothness
distinctive_assumptions.details: Only the real separable Hilbert space E and initial point x0 are public. L,Δ,σ,p,ε are hidden from the algorithm constructor; execution is truncated at the supplied parameter-dependent budget.

distinctive_assumptions.label: heavy_tailed_noise
distinctive_assumptions.details: Uniform central moment bound E‖g(x,ω)−∇f(x)‖^p≤σ^p for 1<p≤2 and σ≥0; finite variance is not required when p<2.

distinctive_assumptions.label: non_euclidean_geometry
distinctive_assumptions.details: The ambient space is a complete real inner-product space with its Borel measurable structure and second-countable topology; finite dimension is not assumed.

accuracy.label: gradient_norm
accuracy.details: A measurable E-valued output X must have integrable gradient norm and satisfy E‖∇f(X)‖≤ε, with ε>0.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: Expectation is over independent algorithm randomness and the i.i.d. oracle stream, under a fixed parameter-dependent cap on oracle calls.

setup_category.label: classical
setup_category.reason: Smooth lower-bounded nonconvex optimization with unbiased i.i.d. gradients having a bounded central p-th moment is an established heavy-tailed stochastic optimization formulation, including study of unknown problem parameters.

descriptionHtml:
Parameter-Free Heavy-Tailed Stationarity

We consider a differentiable, possibly nonconvex function f:E→R on a separable real Hilbert space E, with hidden gradient Lipschitz constant L>0. A given point x0∈E satisfies f(x0)−ℓ≤Δ for a global lower bound ℓ∈R and Δ>0. The oracle returns an unbiased stochastic gradient g(x,ξ) at x, using independent samples ξ with common law ν, with centered pth moment at most σp, where 1<p≤2 and σ≥0. For ε>0, the goal is E∥∇f(x¯)∥≤ε for an output x¯∈E, averaging over sampling and algorithm randomness.

The underlying optimization problem is infx∈Ef(x). The norm ∥⋅∥ is induced by the inner product on E, and E carries its Borel sigma-algebra. The algorithm receives only E and x0; the parameters L, Δ, σ, p, and ε may enter the oracle-call budget but are not algorithm inputs.

Our assumptions:

Assumption 1 (Smoothness and initial gap). The function f is Fréchet differentiable everywhere, and ∥∇f(x)−∇f(y)∥≤L∥x−y∥,x,y∈E. There exists ℓ∈R such that ℓ≤f(x)for every x∈E,f(x0)−ℓ≤Δ.

Assumption 2 (Heavy-tailed stochastic gradients). Let Ω be a measurable sample space and ν a probability measure on Ω. The map g:E×Ω→E is jointly measurable. For every x∈E, g(x,⋅) is Bochner integrable, the random variable ∥g(x,ξ)−∇f(x)∥p is integrable for ξ∼ν, and Eξ∼ν[g(x,ξ)]=∇f(x),Eξ∼ν[∥g(x,ξ)−∇f(x)∥p]≤σp.

At call k, a query x∈E receives g(x,ξk). The sample variables (ξk)k≥0 are measurable and mutually independent with common law ν under their joint probability law. Any algorithm randomness is independent of this sample sequence. Queries may be made at any point of E.

After the allotted oracle calls, the output x¯ must be measurable, ∥∇f(x¯)∥ must be integrable, and EP[∥∇f(x¯)∥]≤ε, where P is the joint law of the algorithm randomness and the sample sequence.

comparisonHtml:
f is differentiable on a complete, second-countable real inner-product space with its Borel structure, ∇f is L-Lipschitz, and f(x0)−flower≤Δ for a global lower bound. IID samples give a jointly measurable, unbiased, integrable gradient oracle with integrable central pth moment at most σp, 1<p≤2. Here L,Δ,ε>0, σ≥0. Target: ∫∥∇f(xout)∥dP≤ε. Only the space and x0 are public; the setup imposes no algorithm restriction.

import LongTails.Template
import LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Gradient.Basic

open MeasureTheory

namespace LongTails.Setups.ParameterFreeHeavyTailedSmooth

open OracleTemplate

structure Public where
  E : Type
  [normedE : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [innerE : InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
  [completeE : CompleteSpace E]
  [measurableE : MeasurableSpace E]
  [borelE : BorelSpace E]
  [countableE : SecondCountableTopology E]
  x0 : E

attribute [instance] Public.normedE Public.innerE Public.completeE Public.measurableE
  Public.borelE Public.countableE

structure Params extends Public where
  Ω : Type
  [measurableΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω]
  L : ℝ
  Δ : ℝ
  σ : ℝ
  p : ℝ
  ε : ℝ

attribute [instance] Params.measurableΩ

abbrev spec : Setup where
  Params := Params
  Public := Public
  Instance q := q.E → ℝ
  Query q := q.E
  Reply q := q.E
  Output q := q.E
  publicInput q := q.toPublic
  valid q := 0 < q.L ∧ 0 < q.Δ ∧ 0 ≤ q.σ ∧ 1 < q.p ∧ q.p ≤ 2 ∧ 0 < q.ε
  admissible q f O :=
    ∃ (g : q.E → q.Ω → q.E) (ν : ProbabilityMeasure q.Ω) (P : ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → q.Ω)),
    LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID
      (fun k (ξ : ℕ → q.Ω) => ξ k) (ν : Measure _) (P : Measure _) ∧
    O = { Seed := fun _ => q.Ω
          law := P
          answer := fun _ (_, x) ω => g x ω } ∧
    (∀ x, HasGradientAt f (gradient f x) x) ∧
    (∀ x y, ‖gradient f x - gradient f y‖ ≤ q.L * ‖x - y‖) ∧
    (∃ lower : ℝ, (∀ x, lower ≤ f x) ∧ f q.x0 - lower ≤ q.Δ) ∧
    Measurable (Function.uncurry g) ∧
    (∀ x, Integrable (g x) (ν : Measure _)) ∧
    (∀ x, ∫ ω, g x ω ∂(ν : Measure _) = gradient f x) ∧
    (∀ x, Integrable (fun ω => ‖g x ω - gradient f x‖ ^ q.p) (ν : Measure _)) ∧
    (∀ x, ∫ ω, ‖g x ω - gradient f x‖ ^ q.p ∂(ν : Measure _) ≤ q.σ ^ q.p)
  successful q f output P :=
    Measurable output ∧
      Integrable (fun ω => ‖gradient f (output ω)‖) (P : Measure _) ∧
      ∫ ω, ‖gradient f (output ω)‖ ∂(P : Measure _) ≤ q.ε

end LongTails.Setups.ParameterFreeHeavyTailedSmooth
